Bill.BriefDescription: Transferring funds from the budget stabilization account to the general fund.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to transferring funds from the budget stabilizationaccount to the general fund; and making appropriations.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The state treasurer shall transferninety million ninetyeight thousand dollars or as much as is availablefrom the budget stabilization account to the state general fund forfiscal year 2012. (2) The state treasurer shall transfer ninetynine million fourhundred eightyfour thousand dollars or as much as is available fromthe budget stabilization account to the state general fund for fiscalyear 2013.
